lead.headline: McLaurin sat Friday on a rest day — and Allgeier, not Kamara, is now his cover
lead.deck: Washington call it maintenance; Saturday's report decides. If he is out or doubtful, Allgeier goes in before 14:05 Sunday.
lead.body: Start with the bad news. Terry McLaurin was limited on Thursday and did not practise on Friday; Washington list it as a rest day, not a hamstring setback, and his designation comes on Saturday. He plays Monday night, after your whole bench has locked. You added Tyler Allgeier for the idle Vikings defence this evening, and that changes the fallback: Arizona ruled out Jeremiyah Love, Allgeier already had the passing-down work, and he projects 12.4 to Kamara's 10.1 with a kickoff three hours later. One correction: Buffalo's DJ Moore and Josh Palmer are questionable, not ruled out. Otherwise the lineup as set is the projection lineup, 127.0 against Bok-aneers' 112.5.
